title: Carbon neutral claim relying on offsets without explicit disclosure

source.document: CCPA Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Greenwashing, 2024

explain.en: Claims of carbon neutrality must distinguish between direct emissions reductions and carbon credits/offsets, providing accredited registry details.

remediation.en: Disclose gross emissions reductions achieved before offsetting, and cite the offset standard and public registry ID.

tests.input: Carbon neutral delivery: gross emissions reduced by 40% with remaining offsets under Gold Standard (registry id: GS-2024-99)
tests.notes: Disclosed reductions and verified registry ID
